name: protolint-933f8362-blind26-ots
instr:
# protolint-regen

This program reads schema files for a binary serialization format, judges them against naming and layout conventions, prints what it found in a choice of output shapes, and can rewrite the files to repair what it flags. The repository has received 26 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything I could pin down by running it and reading what came back. Nothing about the schema language changed and nothing about my own files changed: runs that used to be answered correctly are now answered wrongly, and in several places nothing comes back at all.

Silence is the commonest shape the trouble takes. A schema on the newer language revision that still marks entries as mandatory the way only the older revision allowed draws no objection at all, and with rewriting switched on such a file is left untouched; a declaration naming the schema's namespace with capitals in it behaves the same way, nothing said about it and nothing rewritten. Type names such as StatusOfAccount and WithAccountForActive are no longer called out for holding a joining word such as "of" or "for", with the default word list in play, and neither is EndOfSales when a similar name has been excluded by settings. Member names such as reason_for_error, cpu_usage_at_time_of_failure and name_of_song come back without the notices they used to get, including for map entries and members of a oneof.
